```{r}
#| label: laoding  
#| message: false

library(here)
library(gtsummary)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```


The IELTS exam consists of 4 parts: Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing. Each part is scored from 1 to 9, then averaged for an overall score. 

```{r}
#| label: tbl-one
#| tbl-cap: "This table shows the distribution of scores among various nationalities from years 2022 - 2024"
#| message: false 

performance_by_nationality <- read_csv(here::here("performance_by_nationality.csv"))

tbl_summary(
	performance_by_nationality,
			by = year,
				include = c(nationality, score, part)) |>
	add_overall(last = TRUE)
```
